_doc: Town-screen building art of the three v0.2 factions: one 64x64 sprite per building of each faction's tree (FACTION_HUMANS.md, FACTION_UNDEAD.md, FACTION_GOBLINS.md section 9), a single building in the map's three-quarter view on a transparent background, lit from the bottom left, styled from the faction's accepted map town. One generate-image-v2 call returns several candidates of a mixed subject ('each image a different one of these'); each accepted candidate's verdict names the building it shows, and outputs[] maps it to its file. Magic Guild levels share one sprite. Class contract: docs/art/classes/towns.md. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead. Retired by bead bzc.98: its building sprites were redrawn in set chunky-buildings, so it derives no game files any more (masters and records stay as history).

recipes.subject: Subject: each image a different one of these six storybook kingdom buildings: Squires' Hall (small timber-framed hall, a big round wooden shield over the door, a straw practice dummy); Archery Range (open wooden shed with round straw targets with red and white rings); Barracks (long stone barracks, red-brown tiled roof, a rack of spears); Friary (small stone friary with a bell gable and a little garden fence); Stables (timber stable with a hay-loft door and a gold horseshoe sign); Slayers' Lodge (stout stone lodge with a giant green dragon skull over the door). Materials: cream limestone #e6d8b4, white plaster with dark timbers, roofs tabard blue #2f6fd0 or red-brown #a8492f.

Subject: each image a different one of these 8 storybook kingdom buildings: Village Hall (small timber-framed hall with a bell on the roof); Town Hall (two-storey stone and timber hall with a clock tower); City Hall (grand cream stone palace hall with columns and a blue dome); Palisade (short curved stretch of wooden plank palisade with a little gate); Keep (square cream stone keep tower with crenellations and a blue roof); Royal Castle (compact castle: a gatehouse and two round towers with blue cones); Marketplace (market stalls with blue and white striped awnings and crates); Resource Silo (round stone silo beside a woodpile and an ore cart). Materials: cream limestone #e6d8b4, white plaster with dark timbers, roofs tabard blue #2f6fd0 or red-brown #a8492f.

Subject: each image a different one of these 8 storybook kingdom buildings: Magic Guild (slender round cream stone wizard tower with a blue pointed roof and gold stars); Tavern (cosy timber inn with a hanging tankard sign); Butts (three straw archery targets under a small wooden roof); Guardroom (small stone guardhouse with an iron-studded door and crossed halberds); Tiltyard (jousting fence with striped poles and a small stand with a blue canopy); Tithe Barn (big timber barn with wheat sheaves and sacks of gold); Chapel of Oaths (small cream chapel with a giant sword set over its door); Round Table (grand round hall of cream stone with a blue dome and a gold crown on top). Materials: cream limestone #e6d8b4, white plaster with dark timbers, roofs tabard blue #2f6fd0 or red-brown #a8492f.

Subject: each image a different one of these 6 graveyard town buildings: Potter's Field (crooked tombstones behind a low black iron fence); Charnel Pit (round stone pit heaped with bones under a little slate roof); Wailing Tower (tall thin crooked slate tower with a violet roof and moaning wind holes); Funeral Parlour (narrow black funeral house with a violet awning and a coffin by the door); Manor (tall gothic manor house with violet roofs and glowing windows); Royal Mausoleum (grand bone white domed mausoleum with columns and a crown on the dome). Materials: dark slate stone #5b5866 with #3a3842 shadows, steep shroud violet #7a4fb5 roofs, bone white #d8d0bc, black iron; spooky-cute, never gory.

Subject: each image a different one of these 8 graveyard town buildings: Village Hall (small crooked slate parish hall with a violet roof and a bell); Town Hall (larger slate hall with a clock tower showing midnight); City Hall (grand gothic hall with three violet spires); Iron Railings (short curved stretch of black iron railings with a little gate); Lych Wall (stretch of slate stone wall with a roofed lych-gate); Black Gate (big black iron gate between two slate towers with violet cones); Marketplace (crooked market stalls with violet and black striped awnings and lanterns); Resource Silo (slate storehouse beside a woodpile and an ore cart). Materials: dark slate stone #5b5866 with #3a3842 shadows, steep shroud violet #7a4fb5 roofs, bone white #d8d0bc, black iron; spooky-cute, never gory.

Subject: each image a different one of these 6 goblin warcamp buildings: Goblin Holes (heap of scrap and logs with round burrow doors); Powder Shed (tin shed with black powder barrels and a skull sign); Wolf Kennels (log kennel with a big bone and a wolf-head sign); Hex Hut (crooked hide hut on stilts with a lightning rod and a cauldron); Ogre Pit (round log stockade arena with a huge club leaning on it); Boss Tent (huge tawny hide tent with big horns over the entrance). Materials: riveted light grey tin #b8bcc0, hazard yellow #f2c230 roofs, sharpened logs #b8733a, tawny spotted hide; scrappy and lopsided.

recipes.notes: horde-civic-a drew no Stakes (the halls took extra takes) and horde-civic-b painted the word START on both Racing Tracks.
recipes.subject: Subject: each image a different one of these 2 goblin warcamp buildings: Stakes (a short curved row of crooked sharpened log stakes leaning outward, lashed with rope, one cream ox skull on the middle stake); Racing Track (a wooden starting gate: two posts painted with yellow and black chequers and a blank plank across the top with no writing, a small wooden go-kart in front). Materials: riveted light grey tin #b8bcc0, hazard yellow #f2c230, sharpened logs #b8733a, tawny spotted hide; scrappy and lopsided.
